blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur— Labor groups have criticized the P30 to P40 daily wage increases approved for workers in the Ilocos Region, saying the adjustments were insufficient to keep up with rising prices of basic goods. The National Wages and Productivity Commission (NWPC) of the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) approved the new wage orders on Wednesday, Nov. 25, with the increases in Ilocos scheduled to take effect on Dec. 14 and those in Cagayan Valley on Dec. 16.
